title: Trigonometric Functions: y = a sin x + q, y = a cos x + q, y = a tan x + q
seo_title: Grade 10 Trigonometric Functions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Investigate the effect of the parameters a and q on the graphs of y = a sin x + q, y = a cos x + q and y = a tan x + q; point by point plotting of the basic graphs for θ ∈ [0°; 360°].
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 worksheets: graphs of y = a sin x + q, y = a cos x + q and y = a tan x + q, amplitude, period, range and asymptotes. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Period: 360° for sin and cos, 180° for tan.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • a stretches the graph: the amplitude of a sin x or a cos x is |a|.
  • q moves the graph up or down: maximum = |a| + q, minimum = −|a| + q.
  • In Grade 10 the period stays 360° for sin and cos and 180° for tan.
  • tan x has asymptotes at x = 90° and x = 270°.

Examples

Example

y = 2 sin x − 1

amplitude 2

max 2 − 1 = 1

min −2 − 1 = −3

Answer: y ∈ [−3; 1]

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting qAdd q to the maximum and minimum.
The perioda does not change it in Grade 10.
The rangeShift it by q.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 10 say about trig functions?
faq.a: Investigate the effect of a and q on y = a sin x + q, y = a cos x + q and y = a tan x + q, and sketch the graphs.

faq.q: Does tan x have an amplitude?
faq.a: No, it has no maximum or minimum.

faq.q: What does a negative a do?
faq.a: Reflects the graph in the line y = q.
